name: Email-capture hero
definition: Hero whose call to action is an inline email field and button, with inline error and success states.
bestUse: Waitlists, trials and newsletters where an email is the only ask.

demo.how: The field sits right under the promise, so signing up takes one step. Type an email and press Join: an invalid address shows an inline error next to the field, a valid one replaces the form with a confirmation. Nothing is sent anywhere; the form is simulated.
